summary: Frontend-only responsive verification of Travel Visa, Daily Meditation, AI Writer/Fitness regression, and /admin-system after the global responsive fixes. Tested at 390 / 768 / 1280 / 1920 breakpoints via localhost:3000 (per instructions). Login works for both free and admin users. Most responsive goals are met — Travel Visa header is de-duplicated (2 occurrences, not 4), no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint, content is centered at max-width ~1240 on 1920, tab switching works for tv-v2-tab-progress/certificates/quiz/embassy, Daily Meditation & AI Writer & Fitness render cleanly, and admin pages render at both mobile & desktop with no teal-border corruption. Found ONE clear responsive bug at 768px on the Travel Visa READINESS KPI card and ONE static-export staleness issue where the tv-v2-kpi-* data-testids are not present in the served DOM (source has them but the built Expo static export was not rebuilt with the latest changes).

ui_bugs.issue: At tablet width 768px the READINESS KPI card is crushed to a very narrow width, causing the 'READINESS' label to render vertically (one letter per line) and '0%' to wrap. The PLAN card also wraps to a second row alone. Root cause: on line 293 the readiness card uses inline style { flex: 1, ... } (flex-basis 0) while the other 3 KPI cards use kpiCard which sets flexBasis '22%'. With flex-wrap enabled the basis-0 card gets whatever tiny space is leftover after the 22%-basis siblings claim theirs. Fix: give the readiness card the same kpiCard style (drop the ad-hoc { flex: 1, ... } inline style), so all 4 cards share flexBasis '22%' and wrap symmetrically to 2x2 at narrow widths.

The KPI cards render visually with correct content (Countries 30 / Categories 480 / Readiness 0% / Plan FREE) but automation cannot select them by data-testid. Since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is served by a static Expo web export (frontend supervisor process is intentionally 'no such process'), the source code was updated but the export was NOT rebuilt. critical_code_review_comments: TravelVisaMain.tsx line 293: readiness card uses inline { flex: 1, ... } instead of shared kpiCard style. This breaks the flex-wrap 2x2 grid at narrow widths because it defaults to flex-basis 0 while its siblings use flex-basis 22%. Please reuse kpiCard for all 4 KPI cards, and either move the shared style into a StyleSheet.create or into a memoized const to avoid re-computation.

TravelVisaMain.tsx maintains two parallel testID + data-testid attributes on some elements but only data-testid on others (e.g. KPI cards). Recommend consistency: either always dual-emit or centralize via a helper (React Native Web already maps testID -> data-testid so dual-emit is redundant but harmless). This will remove confusion when writing E2E.

The static Expo web export deployment breaks the normal hot-reload contract that most reviewers assume — please make sure CI publishes the export on every source change so testids added in the working tree are actually testable end-to-end.

readiness_kpi_at_768px.reproduction: 1) Login as free user 2) goto /features/travel-visa 3) Skip onboarding 4) resize browser to 768x1024 5) observe first KPI row: Countries (~230px) | Categories (~230px) | READINESS (vertically-crushed, ~40px wide) then PLAN wraps to a second row alone.
readiness_kpi_at_768px.root_cause: TravelVisaMain.tsx line 293 gives the readiness card `style={{ flex: 1, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.border, backgroundColor: colors.card, padding: 12 }}`, whereas its 3 siblings use `kpiCard` (line 79: `{ flexGrow: 1, flexBasis: (isMobile ? '45%' : '22%'), ... }`). With flex-wrap enabled the sibling cards claim 22% flex-basis each, leaving the readiness card (which has flex-basis 0 because `flex:1` expands to `flex:1 1 0%`) to grab only leftover space — at 768px that leftover is too narrow for the 'READINESS' label and value.
readiness_kpi_at_768px.mitigation: Replace the inline style on line 293 with `style={kpiCard}` (identical to siblings). Optionally also drop `isMobile ? '45%' : '22%'` in favor of a 3-way breakpoint (e.g. `<=480: '45%'`, `481-1024: '30%'`, `>1024: '22%'`) to give tablets a cleaner 3-column or 2x2 layout.

kpi_testids_missing_from_dom.reproduction: 1) Login as free user 2) goto /features/travel-visa 3) Skip onboarding 4) In devtools console run: document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="tv-v2-kpi-"]').length -> 0. Compare with grep in /app/frontend/src/components/travel-visa/TravelVisaMain.tsx which shows 4 KPI data-testid attributes.
kpi_testids_missing_from_dom.root_cause: Static Expo web export served on localhost:3000 was not rebuilt after the KPI-testid additions. Frontend supervisor is intentionally 'no such process' so there is no automatic rebuild.
kpi_testids_missing_from_dom.mitigation: Run the export rebuild pipeline (yarn export:web / expo export -p web) then serve the newly generated /dist to localhost:3000.
